description: PURPOSE: Search everything The Living Bread holds with one free-text query: a flat list of results with ids for search then fetch (mode results, the default, the ChatGPT connector contract), one grounded answer with sourced entities and up to 3 verses (mode answer), or one lb: URN resolved to its public object and JSON Schema (mode protocol). WHEN TO USE: a question no other tool fits, deep research that wants ids to fetch, or an lb: URN to resolve. WHEN NOT: a known reference or exact words: read_scripture. A feeling: find_scripture_for. Churches by place: find_churches. One named denomination or saint: learn_the_faith (mode heritage). MODES (required parameters in brackets): results [query] tried in order as a Bible reference, a need, an entity question, a place, and community words. answer [query, one question per call]. protocol [query, an lb: URN such as lb:ministry:hope-for-a-good-life]. OUTPUT: mode, answered_by, and: results gives results [{id, title, text, url}], never empty (no match returns one result linking home); answer gives question, answer (null when nothing sourced), entities [{id, type, name, url, source}], scripture {topic, url, verses} or null, road_to_christ, next_steps and grounding; protocol gives found, protocol_kind, object, schema and source. BEHAVIOR: read only; queries the Christian Knowledge API live. answer stays null and entities empty rather than a guess. The query text (never a user id) is logged anonymously. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

mode.description: Which kind of answer: results, answer, protocol. Default results. Each mode is explained in the description.

query.description: Free text, 1 to 300 characters: a reference ("Psalm 23"), a need ("anxiety"), a name ("Augustine"), a place ("Lagos"), a question, or an lb: URN for mode protocol.

name: search

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Search The Living Bread
